narrative.title: The ER Triage Board
narrative.scenario: An emergency room keeps a triage board where the most critical patient is always at the top. New arrivals slot in without breaking that rule, and discharging the top patient promotes exactly one successor. The board supports three moves: admit a patient, discharge the most critical one, and peek at who is next. Build the board so every operation stays logarithmic.
narrative.inputFormat: A list of operations: ["insert", value], ["removeMin"], or ["minElement"].
narrative.outputFormat: Return the list of values produced by every minElement operation, in order; a peek on an empty heap yields -1.
constraints: insert, removeMin: O(log n); minElement: O(1)

testCases.explanation: 3 bubbles to the top; after discharging it, 5 becomes the new minimum.
Peeking an empty board returns -1 before any patient arrives.

hintLevels: Level 1: The heap is a complete tree flattened into an array — parent i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2.
Level 2: Insert bubbles the new value up; remove swaps the last element to the root and sifts it down.
Level 3: Sift-down always swaps with the SMALLER child — swapping with the wrong one breaks the invariant.
